items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: Tolles and I, we were just coming back to New Orleans to make that trip with his father to go to Mexico.

ctx.x: So, I played it and we calmed down all right. So, they took all the rest of the boys up for a ride. So, Tolles, we played a little trick on him. We told the pilot that Tolles said he didn't care what you would do with him when he'd get him up in the plane. There was nothing he could do to scare him. So, the pilot said, that's what he said. He said, well, I'm going to fix him. So, he took the plane up with Tolles in it. The plane looked to be about two foot long, looking at it from the ground. And he did the…
What about this experience of going to Mexico with the jazz band?

items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: I was with Nat Tolles' father. ... No, Nat Tolles' father's band.

ctx.x: And we all split up. And Tolles and I, we were just coming back to New Orleans to make that trip with his father to go to Mexico. And we got as far as Shreveport, Louisiana, and by that time, Tolles had been bought a big 57-mile Cadillac. And the car broke down, and he wouldn't leave the car. So, I came home on the train, and I went to see his father. So, his father had difficulty in getting musicians to leave. They was afraid to cross the Gulf on the boat. So, I told him I would leave. So, I had to go to the…
Well, you and Tolles' father, were they only two on this trip? Or was there a troop? Who was that? You and Tolles' father?
No, no. I was with Nat Tolles' father. He stood in Threeport with his car.
